newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain says group held for arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain says group held for arson attack.

text.p: Bahrain said on Wednesday it had arrested a group of people accused of carrying out an arson attack earlier this month.
An official statement faxed to Reuters said Hamad Isa al-Mawlani, 21, was the main suspect in the group.

They were accused of an arson attack on a Hussainiya, a Shi'ite Moslem gathering place, in Jidhafs village on July 11. The statement described them as a group of saboteurs, but gave no further details.
Residents said on Wednesday police toured Shi'ite villages on Tuesday night, asking villagers to switch off loudspeakers used by Shi'ite clerics in Hussainiya houses.
A series of arson attacks hit Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, in the past two months in which six Asians died.

More than 30 people have been killed in the Gulf Arab state since anti-government protests, bombings and arson attacks by the island's majority Shi'ite community began in December 1994. Hundreds of people had been detained.
